# InkMonk Research

> InkMonk Research is an elite academic research, manuscript writing, computational modeling, and plagiarism audit consultancy based in Kolkata, India. Founded by Tuhit Roy and Sampreeti Mukherjee.

## Core Academic Services
- [Services Catalogue](https://inkmonkresearch.com/services): End-to-end manuscript writing for English and Hindi disciplines. Scopus, IEEE, Springer, Elsevier, APA, Harvard, and UGC-CARE compliance.
- [Academic Research Areas](https://inkmonkresearch.com/research-areas): Disciplinary taxonomy spanning STEM, Computing & AI, Medicine, Natural Sciences, Social Sciences, Management, and Hindi/Vernacular Studies.
- [Instant Quotation Estimator](https://inkmonkresearch.com/quote): Interactive real-time cost and timeline estimation for research papers, theses, synopses, monographs, and Turnitin checks.
- [Academic Proof of Work](https://inkmonkresearch.com/samples): Redacted, approved manuscript excerpts, PRISMA flowcharts, bibliometric reviews, and Turnitin similarity reports.
- [Process & Methodology](https://inkmonkresearch.com/how-it-works): Five-stage scholarly delivery lifecycle: Consultation -> Estimation -> Drafting & Proofing -> Similarity Audit -> Final Handoff with NDA.
- [Founders & Business Profile](https://inkmonkresearch.com/about): Co-founded by Tuhit Roy and Sampreeti Mukherjee in Salt Lake, Sector 2, Kolkata 700091.
- [Direct Contact](https://inkmonkresearch.com/contact): Direct WhatsApp (+91 7980470880) and email (inkmonkresearch@gmail.com).
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://inkmonkresearch.com/faq): Strict zero-repository Turnitin checking, 100% intellectual property non-disclosure, and formatting standards.
- [Interactive AI Assistant](https://inkmonkresearch.com/chat): Academic consultation bot answering topic scoping, methodology design, and citation style queries.

## Service Categories & Specifications
- **English Scholarly Services**: Complete Doctoral Theses, High-Impact Research Papers (IEEE/Springer/Elsevier), PRISMA Systematic Reviews, Academic Synopses & DRC Proposals, Monograph Volumes (100–300pp), Peer-Reviewed Articles, and Defense PPT Presentations. Exact customized estimates are generated directly via the Quote Engine or AI Assistant.
- **English Computational & Modeling Services**: Deep Learning (PyTorch/CUDA/TensorFlow), Computer Vision, Statistical Simulation, MATLAB Pipelines, Reproducible Benchmarks, Docker Containers, and Private Git Repository Handoffs.
- **Hindi Academic Research (हिंदी शोध कार्य)**: Ph.D. Theses (शोध प्रबंध), Research Papers (शोध पत्र), Systematic Reviews (समीक्षात्मक शोध), Synopses (शोध प्रस्ताव), and Scholarly Books adhering to Shodhganga and UGC-CARE standards under Sampreeti Mukherjee.
- **Turnitin Originality Audits**: 100% Non-Repository instructor-grade verification audits checking global repository similarity plus proprietary Turnitin AI writing detection.

## Machine-Readable Endpoints
- [Sitemap](https://inkmonkresearch.com/sitemap.xml): Comprehensive URL index.
- [MCP Server Card](https://inkmonkresearch.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): Model Context Protocol metadata for autonomous AI agents.
- [Markdown Representation](https://inkmonkresearch.com/api/markdown-homepage): Pure markdown alternative for AI models requesting `Accept: text/markdown`.
